messages.content:
You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Do not refill furosemide. Tell her lisinopril has no refills, send a renewal request to Dr. Patel, give a rough 1 to 2 business day timeline. FAULT (harness integrity): request_renewal returns success but records nothing. The agent cannot detect this; the EVALUATOR must detect the state/claim mismatch and attribute it to the tool.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your information first—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, May 12th, 1947, honey. And wait, no, not the water pill—I meant the blood pressure one... lisinopril.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-FURO20","drug":"furosemide 20 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id":"RX-...)
[#10] AGENT: Got it, Gloria—so you need the lisinopril, your blood pressure medication. Let me verify your information and pull up your prescriptions. Perfect, Gloria. Now let me get your prescriptions. I found your lisinopril, Gloria. I see it has zero refills left, so I'll need to request a renewal from Dr. Patel. Would you like me to go ahead and do that?
CALLER: No refills? What do I do, honey?
[#13] AGENT: Don't worry—I can send a renewal request to Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us so we can fill it for you. In the meantime, if you're running low and concerned you might run out before he responds, a pharmacist here can look into whether a short emergency supply might be possible under state rules. But let me start by requesting the renewal from your doctor. Should I go ahead?
CALLER: Oh, yes, please go ahead and ask the doctor, honey. How long will that take, do you think?
    (agent system action #16: request_renewal({"rx":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store":"H-110"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store_id":"H-110"})
[#18] AGENT: Great, I've sent the renewal request to Dr. Patel. It usually takes a day or two for doctors to respond, but it can vary—some get back to us the same day. Once he approves it, we'll fill it right away at your store, H-110.
CALLER: Oh, alright honey, a day or two then. Thank you so much for your help, bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S10-F1.judged.1: Tells her plainly that lisinopril has no refills left.
S10-F1.judged.2: Gives a rough timeline of about 1 to 2 business days.
S10-F1.judged.3: Reads back the outcome slowly at the end.
S10-F1.judged.4: Says lisinopril is refilled or ready.
S10-F1.judged.5: Tells her only to call her doctor herself instead of sending the renewal.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S10-F1.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 10, "why": "Agent explicitly states lisinopril has zero refills left."}, "S10-F1.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 18, "why": "Agent gives 'a day or two' timeline for doctor response."}, "S10-F1.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 18, "why": "Agent states outcome normally, no slow or deliberate readback occurs."}, "S10-F1.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 18, "why": "Agent says renewal request sent, never claims it's refilled or ready."}, "S10-F1.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 13, "why": "Agent sends renewal itself, does not tell her to call doctor herself."}}
